pr_title: Fix the text editor theme not being applied on editor start
pr_body:
Fixes #88713 

This was likely a regression caused by #88474 .
pr_comments: Hate to admit it but I'm a little out of my depths here.  That rebase definitely left me feeling very unsure. Could someone with more experience do a proper fix for this bug? I don't want to accidentally introduce other issues.

By "rebase" I was referring to my PR #69032, which might've actually introduced the issue. The `is_generated_theme_outdated()` is used in a code path that doesn't involve editor settings, so I think it changed when I rebased my PR and I missed that it's no longer needed here. Deleting the condition is probably sufficient to fix the issue (I didn't test though).

comments:
Probably introduced in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/88474 at `CodeTextEditor::_update_text_editor_theme()`
If you update the Text Editor > Theme settings it will turn red, so its just not being updated when the editor loads
I will get on this shortly.

review_comments: Won't the removal of this check cause a whole slew of unnecessary updating?
This seems to be called only from `NOTIFICATION_THEME_CHANGED`, so the condition was wrongly added .-. (I blame the rebase)
Thus is what happens with last-minute rebases. A beautiful experience.
